comparison.objective: Lift and tip a heavy two-handled pot, pour its contents, and return it to the hob.
comparison.physical_skill: Synchronized bimanual load support, coordinated tipping, and spill control.
comparison.success_condition: Required contents transferred with limited spill and the pot returned upright; candidate instead requires hex-key work, collar tuning, and safe stopping cycles.
comparison.reason: Both involve bimanual force coordination, but their core tested abilities and terminal states are different.
